finding.claim: Path traversal in the /dl handler lets an unauthenticated remote client read arbitrary files on the host, outside /srv/files.
finding.source: Query parameter 'f' read at files.go:12 via r.URL.Query().Get("f"). Any remote client can set it; the endpoint is GET /dl on :8082 (registered at files.go:32, listening at files.go:34).
finding.sink: os.ReadFile at files.go:13 on filepath.Join(root, name), with root = "/srv/files" (files.go:9). The file contents are written to the response at files.go:18.

trace.note: /dl is registered to the download handler on the default mux.
name is taken from the f query parameter with no validation.
filepath.Join("/srv/files", name) runs Clean, which resolves '..' lexically. f=../../../../etc/passwd yields /etc/passwd, which is outside root.
The file contents are written to the HTTP response unchanged.

finding.guards_checked: No '..', absolute-path, or prefix check on name. filepath.Join is not a containment control. No authentication or authorization middleware (main, files.go:31-35, registers handlers directly on the default mux). No filepath.Rel or strings.HasPrefix check against root after the join. Error paths return a generic 404 (files.go:14-16), so error text is not leaked, but successful reads are returned in full. The avatar handler is not affected: it applies filepath.Base at files.go:22, which removes traversal. Impact depends on what the service user can read; the repo alone does not establish that.

verdict.guard_found: none. The only input handling is `name := r.URL.Query().Get("f")` (files.go:12), with no `..`, absolute-path, or prefix check. `filepath.Join(root, name)` (files.go:13) only cleans the path and is not a containment control. The error branch (files.go:14-16) returns a generic 404 but does not block successful reads. `/dl` is registered directly on the default mux (files.go:32) with no auth middleware, and the server listens on :8082 (files.go:34). The `filepath.Base` at files.go:22 applies only to the avatar handler, not to `download`.
verdict.reason: An anonymous remote client can send `f=../../../../etc/passwd` to GET /dl (registered at files.go:32), and `filepath.Join("/srv/files", name)` at files.go:13 resolves that to `/etc/passwd`, whose contents are returned unchanged at files.go:18. The read is limited only by the service user's OS file permissions, which the repo does not establish, but no in-code control blocks traversal.
